items.title: Faster and Cheaper Search With Qdrant 1.20
items.summary: With Qdrant 1.20, we shipped two main features that can make your search cheaper and faster: two new quantization-native datatypes (turbo8 and turbo16) and advanced metadata indexing for nested fields. We measured the performance and cost improvements so you don’t have to, and in this blog post we go through our findings.Reduce Your Disk Usage, Not Your RecallStoring vectors is always the main expense when it comes to semantic search: they cost disk when cold, and memory when warm.
items.creator: info@qdrant.tech (Andrey Vasnetsov)
